description: Validates an EU 8-to-10 digit TARIC / HS Customs Classification Code. Verifies chapter hierarchy, numerical syntax, checks against EU customs nomenclature, and audits alignment with provided goods description.

goodsDescription.description: Commercial description of the imported/exported merchandise.

tariffCode.description: The 8-digit CN or 10-digit TARIC code (e.g. '8481.20.90' or '8481209000').
